title: Taking steroids is cheating | Natural Bodybuilder Reacts
summary: NH reacts to Jubilee's natural vs enhanced bodybuilding debate, arguing the real question is whether steroids are dangerous, not whether they are cheating. He attacks enhanced arguments (low-test epidemic, water analogy, TRT, lasting gains), criticizes honest PED influencers for normalizing drugs to kids, and argues enhanced bodybuilding is choking the sport while natural bodybuilding should be promoted on human potential.
claims: The steroid debate should be about danger, not cheating; framing it as cheating or 'bad' is a strawman that paints naturals as moralizers

Recent deaths of respected bodybuilders in their 40s (e.g. Cedric McMillan, Shawn Rhoden, Dallas McCarver, George Peterson) show steroid danger; some PED-related deaths were suicides from mental health effects
Natural bodybuilding is the fountain of youth; enhanced bodybuilding loses the health benefits and keeps only the aesthetic byproduct, gains you won't keep for a shorter life
Most PED users are not veteran naturals in their 30s but young beginners, sometimes teenagers, following influencers who trained under six months natty before jumping on
There is no distinction between steroid use and abuse; use leads to abuse, as with any hard drug

The falling-testosterone argument is cope: lower population averages reflect modern lifestyle, not reduced biological capacity, and test rises again with an active lifestyle; enhanced users run 10-15 times normal levels anyway
Comparing steroids to drinking too much water is a false analogy
Real TRT replaces hormones you can't produce due to a diagnosed condition; most TRT clinics now give testosterone to anyone, making TRT a legal loophole for steroid use
When he had his testosterone tested, the doctor said his levels were normal yet offered TRT to optimize them

IFBB pros he has seen train do baby weights and high reps; the most intense training comes from naturals because drugs do so much that enhanced lifters can do anything, so their training advice is worthless
Naturals look bad because they take advice from PED users whose results come from drugs, not training
Smoking spreads by peer pressure and tobacco lobbying making it look cool, and PED influencers do the same on YouTube; speaking against it prevents normalization
Never let your 17- or 20-year-old self make decisions that will impact your 40-year-old self
Steroids leveling bad genetics is the only semi-valid argument, but it is whiny, and someone who needs PEDs to look remotely big won't have a career, so they sacrifice health for nothing
Steroids do not give lasting muscle via extra myonuclei/satellite cells in practice: once off, hormones can't sustain the mass and users lose their gains and more

Natural competitive bodybuilding is unhealthy because naturals are forced into enhanced standards of extreme leanness; if naturals competed at 13-14% bodyfat and women with curves, they'd look bigger and keep healthy hormones
Female natural competitors often have trouble getting pregnant later because extreme dieting tanks their hormones
Fake naturals are no longer the main problem; honest enhanced influencers are, because their openness promotes steroids
Coaches who push natural clients onto drugs or aromatase inhibitors to win shows only care about their reputation and should be sueable
The first wave of educational PED content (e.g. Tren videos) caused kids to harm themselves; only a new wave of natural lifting can reverse it
Comparing yourself to others is the thief of joy; the solution is high natural standards and removing PED users from setting the standards
Many PED users had average genetics, so they assume genetically elite naturals must also cheat; he has met genetic monsters who were clearly natural
A 5 can only achieve what a 5 can; rejoice at a 10's potential and go back to your own grind
Mainstream steroid use made people accuse anyone who looks good of being enhanced, lowering hope rather than raising standards
As a natural you can never build too much muscle because the body has limits; PEDs remove those limits at the expense of health
Enhanced lifters who get winded on stairs or whose low back cramps climbing stairs are in a Stockholm-syndrome-like abusive relationship with the drugs
When he was overweight he got ankle pain from walks and that was enough for him to lose weight
Bodybuilding has been dying since the Golden Era because physiques became unrelatable; it is now a niche sport for people who like freaks
Natural bodybuilding cannot go mainstream while enhanced exists, since people prefer seeing 280 lb freaks; enhanced bodybuilding is choking the sport
Bigfoot analogy: if a natural beat enhanced competitors, everyone would assume he was enhanced, and they'd be right since a natural cannot beat enhanced
Natural bodybuilding should be sold on human potential like the WNBA inspires girls, whereas enhanced bodybuilding only encourages people to take drugs
Natural influencers serve men like a wife urging caution: they present factual reasons against risk-taking, and if the kid still chooses drugs at least prevention was attempted
Regular bloodwork doesn't make PED use safe, like scanning while smoking only catches the cancer earlier; Bumstead already had organ failure once
Jubilee picks the most influential but least sharp guests for drama, and the natural side barely defended natural bodybuilding
